{{Quote|What is the status of the base?''"<br />"''Uh...we've run into some difficulties. There seem to be a few clones left, sir.|The droid speaking to Grievous|<ref name="Rookiees">{{TCW|Rookies (episode)}}</ref>}}
A '''[[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]''' was stationed on the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of [[Grievous/Legends|General Grievous's]] [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].

==History==
During the [[Defense of Rishi Station/Legends|Battle of the Rishi moon]], this [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] informed Grievous that the reinforcement squadron sent to retake the [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]] had run into some difficulties with a few remaining [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]. Grievous then ordered the droid to tell the squadron to wipe them out.<ref name="Rookiees" />
